title: French Eggplant Bharta
description: A French twist on the Indian-inspired eggplant bharta, with a rich and smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: any variety, but firmer works best

ingredients.name: baingan bharta spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and place it on a baking sheet, cut side up.
Drizzle the eggplant with 1 tablespoon of butter and season with salt.
Roast the eggplant in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until it's tender and caramelized.
While the eggplant is roasting, heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced onions to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until they're dark golden brown and crispy.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
Add the baingan bharta spice mix to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Once the eggplant is done roasting, let it cool slightly, then peel off the skin and chop it into a rough mash.
Add the eggplant mash to the skillet with the onions and spices, and stir to combine.
Season the bharta with salt to taste, then serve hot, garnished with chopped basil and a dollop of crème fraîche if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice for a filling meal.
